title: OpenAI's Decisions API on Luna, in limited preview
summary: OpenAI's Decisions API, built on Luna, is in limited preview, with a broader release "in the coming days." OpenAI says it returns in 150 ms, compared with 1.6 s for GPT-6 Luna, via Frederic Lardinois, The New Stack, 29 Sep 2026. The use is to classify, route, or choose a next action from a fixed list. Price, how many candidate answers, and whether you can tune it on your own data are unstated. The New Stack sets the announcement next to TypeSafe's Jev. That is the reporter's framing, not an OpenAI quote.
